title: From Brief to Delivery, One Process
lead: Sample process flow. Actual timelines, deliverables and milestones to be confirmed per project.

0.title: Inquiry & Brief
0.desc: Share your product idea, formula, goals and target market with our team.

1.title: Feasibility & Proposal
1.desc: We assess raw materials, dosage form, cost and regulatory fit, then propose scope.

2.title: Sample Development
2.desc: Lab samples and prototypes are developed for your review and testing.

3.title: Quote & Agreement
3.desc: Final pricing, MOQ, terms and documentation are agreed in writing.

4.title: Production
4.desc: Manufacturing runs to your approved specification with batch records.

5.title: Quality Control
5.desc: In-process and finished-product testing against the agreed spec.

6.title: Packaging & Labeling
6.desc: Custom packaging, labels and language variants prepared for your market.

7.title: Delivery & Support
7.desc: Export documentation, shipping and post-delivery support.
